items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: I never knew Young to play clarinet. That's right. Well, I knew him to play alto sax or something. And he was a good one.

ctx.x: Did the sport, the young play clarinet or sax all the time? In late years you only played alto sax?

Yeah. I never knew Young to play clarinet. That's right. Well, I knew him to play alto sax or something. And he was a good one. Yeah. And from that band to another band, another show you called Dash and Dinah.
Well, this other, this Broadway, were all the musicians from up north then in Chicago or some of them down here, from here too?
